Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Prepare yourselves for emotional devastation!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Whoa, whoa, guys, what's goin' on?

Name: Buford
Dialog: (pants) It's... I can't tell 'em! You tell 'em, Baljeet!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Due to unresolved contract negotiations, Stumbleberry Finkbat has been cancelled!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: "Cancelled"? "Contract negotiations"? "Stumbleberry Finkbat"?! "DUE TO"?!?!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Whatcha doin'?

Name: Buford
Dialog: What we're doin' is never gettin' the ending of Stumbleberry Finkbat! That's what we're doin'!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (takes out a poster) They're cancelling the show, right before the final episode!

Name: Buford
Dialog: How long you been carryin' around that poster?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Since season two.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Well, when my favorite series, The Goblin's Filibuster, ended, I made an undisclosed amount of fan-fiction to hold me over.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Define "undisclosed amount".

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Undisclosed, Baljeet! That means I don't disclose it!

Name: Buford
Dialog: We're never gonna know how the story finishes!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Unless we live it ourselves! Ferb, I know what we're gonna do today!

Name: The gang
Dialog: Dungeon crawl!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (on phone) Stacy, the boys are doing that thing that they always do.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (over phone) Using their imaginations?

Name: Candace
Dialog: No! Building big, dangerous, bustable things with their imaginations! And also power tools. They even put up flyers. How'd they even get in here? Gotta go! I'll keep ya appraised.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: If you have to... Oh. (Zoom out to reveal Stacy's living room covered in flyers.) They do work fast.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Why is dating so difficult? I'm not finding any matches, even with my Swipe-inator going full— Oh, what! Oh, wait! I just got a match!

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Dad, this is a bot. Her name is literally "Robotina".

Name: Norm
Dialog: Hubba hubba!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Get your own profile, Norm!

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Now, what if, hear me out, you tried meeting someone in the real world?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yes, something real, like in reality, like a reality dating show! That's a great idea!

Name: Vannessa
Dialog: Um, n-no, not exactly what I was talking ab—

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ooh, ooh, they're casting for Passion Villa! Wish me luck!

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: This is really not a good ide— (sighs)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Welcome, fellow LARPers! May I present the Stumbleberry Finkbat Dodecahedron Dungeon Crawl!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: We'll traverse puzzles and traps, creating our own end to the story.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Oh, sweet, sweet closure. Maybe we'll even find the last shard, or face the Puzzle Master, or discover the identity of the man in really dark grey!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hold on, I'm coming with you!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You wanna LARP with us, Candace?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ew, no. But if I'm gonna bust you for this, then I can't let you out of my sight until Mom gets home.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay.

Name: Buford
Dialog: (screams as he falls into a trap door)

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I guess finding Buford could be a side quest.

Name: Dating Show Host
Dialog: The water is wet, the sun is hot. That means love is in the air at Passion Villa! Let's meet our steamy contestants.

Name: Thad
Dialog: (Foot Model/Professional Trainer) My name's Thad. I like shiny things.

Name: Theo
Dialog: (#Influencer) 'Sup? I'm Theo. I brush my own hair.

Name: Evan
Dialog: ("Evan") Evan.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (hesitates) Ih... Is somebody gonna say, "Action", or...? Oh. Oh! We're already rolling, okay! ("Maybe a Pharmacist"?) I'm Heinz Doofen—

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I think I heard Buford this way.

Name: Buford
Dialog: (echoing) I'm over here!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Hmm, a four-pronged fork in the road. How do we know which way to go?

Name: Buford
Dialog: (echoing) This way! Come this way!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: His voice is coming through all four tunnels. Three of them must be traps. (laughs) Cool.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ugh! Let's just go this way.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, that was close!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: If we can triangulate Buford's specific vocal frequency, we can...

Name: Buford
Dialog: (echoing) Nerd alert!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: (sighs) He is that way.

Name: Thad
Dialog: I'm just, like, excited to find someone who I understand. Literally. You know. Small words?

Name: Susanne
Dialog: I want someone so full of themselves, there's barely room for me.

Name: Evan
Dialog: Evan.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I want someone to help take over the Tri-State Area and make me their "guy-state area". Yeah? See what I did there?

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: (puts her head in her hands) I can't look.

Name: Norm
Dialog: I can't look away!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: So we free Buford, find the lost shard, and live out the final episode.

Name: Candace
Dialog: And then I bust you for the nerdiest thing ever.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: There he is!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Ah, my friends!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We gotta be careful. Candace, wait!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ugh, I'm getting outta here. Ridiculous dungeon crawl. Dumb arrows. Stupid traps. Buncha nerdy stuff. Shards and whatever, blah, blah, blah. "Stumbleberry Finkbat". Can't wait to bust all you guys!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (to the gang) Whatta you waiting for?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Whoa, Candace, you're a natural at this!

Name: Buford
Dialog: You were born to LARP!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ew. No.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: C'mon, let's find that last shard and finish the story!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ugh. Everybody's already coupled up. Even this guy.

Name: Evan
Dialog: Evan.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I need to shake things up. (pulls out an inator) With my Shake-It-Up-inator!

Name: Thad
Dialog: Sorry!

Name: Thad's girlfriend
Dialog: Ugh. I can't be with a man who apologizes.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Uh, uh, well, I wanted it to shake up the social dynamic, but making them literally shake also works.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Agent P, you watching this?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: I'm Team Evan and Doof is ruining this! Go, stop him!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: All right! By shaking up the other contestants, I will look grounded and stable by comparison!

Name: Dating Show Host
Dialog: Time to throw in a new player!

Name: Susanne
Dialog: (purrs) Who's this?

Name: Thad's girlfriend
Dialog: I heard he's semiaquatic.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Perry the Platypus? I didn't know you were looking for love. Hmm. I guess we're more alike than I thought.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (gasps) Look! The last shard of Darkling Dungeon! That's what we need to complete the quest in the story!

Name: Buford
Dialog: The juiciest treasures usually have the beefiest defense!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Ahhh! Enigmata Obscura! It is the Puzzle Knight!

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Enigmata Obscura, prepare to meet your doom.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wow, so cool!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wow, we built these animatronics, and I still don't know what they're doing!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: (screams)

Name: Buford
Dialog: How do we defeat this thing?!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (scoffs) This is insane! We're getting outta here, and I'm busting you guys!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Candace, you've figured it out! The switches are magnetized! Everyone, quick, jump on a switch!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: We cannot get off our switches to help! She is doomed!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: It's the Man in Really Dark Grey!

Name: Candace
Dialog: He saved me!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Yeah, we did it!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Jeremy?! No way!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Oh, Jeremy!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: I did not see that coming!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Welcome, hot dog man!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (excitedly) Jeremy?! That was you?!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Yeah. My room was covered in flyers, so I came over. I like LARPing. I get it if you think it's lame.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Could be the adrenaline speaking, but that was so fun!

Name: Buford
Dialog: This is it! This is how Stumbleberry Finkbat ends! The Man in Really Dark Grey swings in to rescue the Freakishly Long-Necked Princess!

Name: Candace
Dialog: "Freakishly", really?

Name: Buford
Dialog: And then uses the last shard of Darkling Tower to defeat the Puzzle Knight!

Name: Candace
Dialog: But nonetheless, I will still be busting you boys.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay, Candace. I'm just glad we got our ending to Stumbleberry Finkbat.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Closure!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: It's no use, Perry the Platypus! I am in this to win this!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Why not? So long, freaks!

Name: Dating Show Host
Dialog: A contestant leaving in the middle of the competition? That's gotta shake things up. Or maybe, it'll have... no effect whatsoever.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom! Traps! Obscure enigmas! Look!

Name: Buford
Dialog: I got antlers!

Name: Candace
Dialog: But, but, but...

Name: Robotina
Dialog: Oh, hi. You must be Norm. I'm Robotina. (She takes off her head to reveal...) I like to LARP as a robot. And it looks like you do, too!

Name: Norm
Dialog: I've been humanfished!
